title: reCAPTCHA v3
body: Overview The BoxLang contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect against spam and automated submissions without displaying a visible CAPTCHA challenge. reCAPTCHA v3 runs in the background and returns a risk score from 0.0 to 1.0 .
